name: Teacher-guided latent compression (TD) -- pure distillation of the SAPPO specialists into one fresh latent student, then Compression Crossover
authority: PI, 2026-09-04: stop patching the compressed policy and test the compression step itself. Phase 1 must be distillation-ONLY (no PPO objective, no critic update, no task reward, no advantage), built as a standalone supervised runner -- NOT by disabling PPO inside the PPO trainer. Both teachers are queried on the SAME states so that z0-vs-z1 difference equals teacher-strategy difference, not state-distribution difference. Keep the real decision-boundary mask.

WHY_THIS_IS_A_DIFFERENT_KIND_OF_EXPERIME.what_every_prior_attempt_did: CCP-S2, RSCFT, trunk-freeze, SAC-RFT, BCS and the queued Z-separation all warm-start from the incumbent (final_ccp_successor_production.zip) and try to repair or preserve specialization AFTER compression.
WHY_THIS_IS_A_DIFFERENT_KIND_OF_EXPERIME.what_the_incumbent_actually_is: confirmed from ccp_successor_production_run_config.json and CCP_SUCCESSOR_MODEL_FROZEN.json#CONFIG_AND_SEED: a FRESH random-init run (fresh_step_0=true, checkpoint_weights_loaded=false, total_timesteps=1000000, seed 11600001) trained by plain PPO with a z-slot. pi_A/pi_B never entered that run. The only place the specialists ever touched a latent network is CCP-S2's sparse winner-directed causal bank (5 of 100 segments, 3.5x z0/z1 imbalance) -- an indirect signal, not distillation.
WHY_THIS_IS_A_DIFFERENT_KIND_OF_EXPERIME.therefore: no direct D_KL(pi_A || pi_theta(.|z0)) + D_KL(pi_B || pi_theta(.|z1)) compression has ever been run in this program. This spec runs it for the first time and measures crossover IMMEDIATELY after, before any RL objective touches the student.

PHASES_AND_THE_THREE_FROZEN_COMPARISONS.phase_0_teachers: SAPPO specialists pi_A, pi_B -- already PASS the identical gate (SPECIALIST_BASELINE_EVAL_RESULT.json: delta_A=+0.1719 [+0.0156,+0.3281], delta_B=+0.2969 [+0.1250,+0.4688], block 11805001..11805064).
PHASES_AND_THE_THREE_FROZEN_COMPARISONS.phase_1_pure_compression: fresh latent student pi_theta(a|s,z), same architecture family as the incumbent (39 parameters, K=2), random init, trained ONLY by teacher KL. Then frozen and evaluated: COMPRESSION CROSSOVER (this spec's primary result).
PHASES_AND_THE_THREE_FROZEN_COMPARISONS.phase_2_ppo_adaptation: ONLY if phase 1 PASSES: normal PPO fine-tuning from the distilled student (a separate, later frozen spec -- not authorized by this file), then a second crossover eval on a fresh block.

reading_matrix.phase1_FAIL: the shared latent architecture could not preserve payoff-level specialization even under direct specialist supervision -- compression itself is the bottleneck; every retention mechanism was repairing damage done at compression
reading_matrix.phase1_PASS_then_phase2_FAIL: compression succeeded; PPO destroyed specialization that compression had preserved -- retention methods finally have a real, isolated problem
reading_matrix.phase1_PASS_then_phase2_PASS: direct distillation was the missing mechanism

DATASET.states_from_both_deployments: roll pi_A against Pole A and pi_B against Pole B (their natural deployments), EQUAL episode counts per pole. Deterministic teacher actions (the deployment convention every eval in this program uses). Every visited pre-action state is stored with the exact observation dict the policies consume (grid, vec, agent_mask, mask, global_state) plus the live decision mask d_ti = [blue_commit_ticks_left_i <= 0] read via rl.causal_supervision.decision_mask_from_core -- missing predicate is fatal, never defaulted.
DATASET.both_teachers_on_the_same_state: at training time BOTH frozen teachers are queried on every stored state (masked logits via rl.custom_ppo.strategy_anchor._masked_heads, the same legality masking PPO's own update applies). z0 is trained toward pi_A(.|s) and z1 toward pi_B(.|s) on the SAME s. Teacher targets are recomputed on the fly from the frozen checkpoints rather than cached, so a single code path produces teacher and student heads.
DATASET.balance: minibatches are stratified by state-origin pole (half from Pole-A deployment states, half from Pole-B deployment states); each row contributes to both KL terms. Difference between z0 and z1 = teacher strategy, not state distribution.
DATASET.decision_boundary_mask_kept: only agent-heads with d_ti = True enter numerator and denominator (same rule as rl/causal_supervision.py). Rows with no free agent are excluded from sampling.
DATASET.holdout: 10% of episodes (by episode id, both poles) held out for KL / agreement diagnostics. Never used for training. NOT a model-selection set: training runs a fixed number of epochs and the terminal weights are the only artifact.
DATASET.collection_seeds: 11921001..11921096 (pi_A vs Pole A) and 11921101..11921196 (pi_B vs Pole B): 96 episodes per pole, 192 total
DATASET.collection_device: cpu, deliberately, so collection does not contend with the in-flight BCS sealed EVAL on the GPU

LOSS.per_head: KL computed per action head (agent-major, matching action_space.nvec), over MASKED softmax distributions; masked-out actions carry zero teacher mass and contribute nothing
LOSS.reduction: sum over decision-boundary heads / count of decision-boundary heads, per teacher term; then the 0.5/0.5 average
LOSS.optimized_parameters: student ACTOR parameters only: every parameter not under 'critic.' (actor_cnn.*, latent_actor.*). Critic heads receive no gradient and must not move (verified, not assumed). The vestigial latent_actor.action_head.* is off the z-conditioned path and receives zero gradient; it is left in the actor set and its immobility is a positive-control check, not a concern.
what_is_absent_by_construction: separation loss (latent_actor_z_separation_coef stays 0 -- one changed variable: distillation alone)

TRAINING.student_init: SharedActorCentralizedCritic constructed with the incumbent checkpoint's own architecture kwargs (parsed from its payload cfg by the checkpoint loader, so the architecture is identical by construction: 39 parameters, same names and shapes -- refused otherwise) and torch.manual_seed(11920001); NO weights loaded. Fresh means fresh.
TRAINING.optimizer: Adam, lr=3e-4, over actor parameters only; grad-norm clip 1.0
TRAINING.schedule: 20 epochs over the decision-bearing rows, minibatch 256, stratified by pole, shuffle seed 11920001. Fixed length; no early stopping; no checkpoint selection; terminal weights only.
TRAINING.fit_check_before_the_eval_is_opened: holdout teacher-agreement (argmax match at decision heads) must be >= 0.50 for BOTH z0-vs-pi_A and z1-vs-pi_B. This is a compression-fidelity preflight, not the crossover gate: if the student does not imitate its teachers, the crossover eval would be testing something other than compression fidelity. A fit failure is recorded (FIT_FAILED) and the eval is NOT opened.
TRAINING.checkpoint_format: the incumbent payload envelope (cfg, ruleset, artifact identity, format, dims) cloned with model_state_dict replaced by the student's weights, global_step=0, the incumbent's optimizer state removed, and a 'teacher_distillation' provenance block added. Loadable by load_custom_ppo_policy exactly like every checkpoint this program has evaluated; verified by a read-back behavioral-identity check before freezing.

MECHANICAL_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED_BEFORE_TRA: dataset loads; decision-bearing rows > 0; both poles present; holdout non-empty
fresh student has exactly the incumbent's parameter names and shapes, and differs from the incumbent's weights (it is not a silent warm start)
teacher self-KL is exactly zero through the same masked-head path (KL(pi_A||pi_A) = 0)
initial distillation loss is finite and > 0
after one backward: nonzero gradient on actor parameters, NO gradient on any critic parameter (positive control)
after one optimizer step: actor parameters moved, every critic parameter bit-identical
checkpoint round-trip: written student reloads via load_custom_ppo_policy with identical masked logits on a real batch

PRIMARY_GATE.criterion: delta_A > 0 AND LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND delta_B > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0
PRIMARY_GATE.rule: same primary gate as every prior stage. No mercy, no reinterpretation.

EVAL_PROTOCOL_COMPRESSION_CROSSOVER.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap over seeds, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7 (experiments.eval_hog_psp_v3._mean_ci)
EVAL_PROTOCOL_COMPRESSION_CROSSOVER.tie_or_reversal: any tie or reversal triggers a row-level integrity audit before interpretation, written before its rows are read
EVAL_PROTOCOL_COMPRESSION_CROSSOVER.context_only_not_a_gate: SPECIALIST_BASELINE_EVAL_RESULT.json's deltas are reported alongside as the ceiling reference (different seed block; descriptive only)

SEEDS.disjointness_confirmed: grepped every literal above and the whole 1192xxxx pattern against every JSON under artifacts/strategic_demand/sppo/ before freezing -- only decimal-fraction false positives (e.g. 0.550000011920929), zero seed uses
